$comment: Music (docs/AUDIO.md §2a): one entry per track, its file beside this one; `playlist` (one file sets it) says how they follow each other: shuffled, never the same twice in a row, a gap of silence drawn in [gapMinS, gapMaxS] after each (minutes, Minecraft-style: music comes and goes at random times), the next starting crossfadeS early (an overlap); `contexts` gives each place the playlist plays (`menu`, `game`) its wait before the first track, drawn in [firstDelayMinS, firstDelayMaxS] (the menu's 0: music at once; a track carried over from the previous page plays on without a wait). A track's optional `times` (`day`, `night`, default both) says when it may be drawn: day while the listener's daylight (the ambience's `day`, 0 night to 1 day) is at least `dayAt`; the menu counts as day, and a playing track finishes when day turns to night. shared/music/gen.mjs validates it and emits client/src/audio/music.gen.ts; the build ships each file once per site under media/ (client/vite.config.ts, scripts/site.ts). `when` picks where a track plays (now only "always"). The tracks: Andrew Sitkov's Total Music Collection (Unity Asset Store), the owner's eight picks (one for nights only), AAC 96 kbps at -18 LUFS (docs/AUDIO.md §2a).
